title: Emberfall's ash-flats sub-rooms (Cracked Flat, Bottle Row, Cinder Roost, The Long Melt, Glassmelt Flats, Ash Furrows, etc.) offer no 'get your bearings (free)' option, unlike the Vale's and Hearthlands' overworld tiles, so the large, visually repetitive flats gave no way to triangulate toward the ridge chapel except manual wandering room by room.
